name: Codex CLI

requirements.name: Rust
requirements.hint: Rust, installed with rustup: https://rustup.rs (it picks up the toolchain each Codex release pins)

requirements.name: Rust
requirements.hint: Rust's cargo, installed with rustup: https://rustup.rs

requirements.name: Python 3
requirements.hint: Python 3.11 or newer, for Codex's package builder

requirements.name: Python 3.11 or newer
requirements.hint: Python 3.11 or newer as python3, for Codex's package builder: this python3 is older (Ubuntu 22.04's is 3.10; Ubuntu 24.04 and later have a newer one; on macOS, brew install python)

requirements.name: a C compiler
requirements.hint: a C compiler: build-essential on Debian or Ubuntu, gcc on Fedora

requirements.name: a C compiler
requirements.hint: a C compiler: Xcode's command line tools (xcode-select --install)

requirements.name: pkg-config
requirements.hint: pkg-config: sudo apt install pkg-config (Debian, Ubuntu) or sudo dnf install pkgconf (Fedora)

requirements.name: libcap's development files
requirements.hint: libcap's development files, for Codex's sandbox: sudo apt install libcap-dev (Debian, Ubuntu) or sudo dnf install libcap-devel (Fedora)

typecheck: cd codex-rs && cargo check -p codex-cli --bin codex
build: cd codex-rs && sed -i.openmods.bak 's/^version\.workspace = true$/version = "'"${OPENMODS_VERSION}+${OPENMODS_MODS}"'"/' cli/Cargo.toml && rm -f cli/Cargo.toml.openmods.bak && { grep -q '^version = "'"${OPENMODS_VERSION}+${OPENMODS_MODS}"'"$' cli/Cargo.toml || { echo 'could not stamp the version: codex-rs/cli/Cargo.toml has no version.workspace = true line' >&2; exit 1; }; } && cd .. && rm -rf codex-rs/target/openmods-package && CODEX_REPO_ROOT="$PWD" CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_OPT_LEVEL=1 CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_DEBUG=none CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_STRIP=symbols CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_LTO=off CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_CODEGEN_UNITS=16 python3 scripts/build_codex_package.py --cargo-profile release --target "$(rustc -vV | sed -n 's/^host: //p')" --package-dir codex-rs/target/openmods-package
dev: (cd {root} && rm -rf codex-rs/target/openmods-dev-package && CODEX_REPO_ROOT={root} python3 scripts/build_codex_package.py --target "$(rustc -vV | sed -n 's/^host: //p')" --package-dir codex-rs/target/openmods-dev-package) && exec {root}/codex-rs/target/openmods-dev-package/bin/codex
